checks: Winners and runners-up from Wikipedia's summary table match the final of each edition in the martj42 international results dataset (with its shoot-out file for finals drawn after extra time). Editions are named by their official year: 2021 was played in early 2022, 2023 in early 2024 and 2025 from December 2025 to January 2026. Most slots for one nation: Cameroon 3, Egypt 2, Algeria 1.
